description.zh: 按讲话人身份、场合和时长撰写领导讲话、会议发言、表态发言、年会和开幕致辞、主持词、竞聘演讲；口语化、好念、时长精确，自动估算朗读时长，并导出大字号照读版 Word。
description.en: Writes speeches, meeting remarks, pledges, welcome and year-end addresses, host scripts, and campaign speeches tuned to the speaker, occasion, and time; estimates speaking time and exports large-print Word.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我谁讲、在什么场合、讲多久、想表达什么
welcome_message.en: Tell me who's speaking, the occasion, the length, and the key message

prompt.zh: 帮我写一篇领导讲话稿。讲话人：___；会议：___；时长约 ___ 分钟；要讲的重点：
prompt.en: Write a speech. Speaker: ___; meeting: ___; about ___ minutes; key points:

prompt.zh: 我要在 ___ 会议上作 ___ 分钟的交流/表态发言，单位情况和主要做法如下：
prompt.en: I'm giving ___ minutes of remarks at ___. Our work and approach:

prompt.zh: 帮我写一篇 ___ 分钟的年会致辞。公司今年的高光时刻和明年目标：
prompt.en: Write a ___-minute year-end address. This year's highlights and next year's goals:

prompt.zh: 帮我写一篇 3 分钟以内的致辞。活动：___；讲话人身份：___；出席嘉宾：___。
prompt.en: Write remarks under 3 minutes. Event: ___; speaker: ___; guests: ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我写主持词（单人/双人）。活动流程如下：
prompt.en: Write a host script (solo/duo). Run of show:

prompt.zh: 帮我写一篇 ___ 分钟的竞聘演讲。竞聘岗位：___；我的经历和业绩：
prompt.en: Write a ___-minute campaign speech for ___. My background and results:

zh: 每周一「09:00」根据本周会议安排，列出需要准备的讲话稿和截止时间
每次例会前一天「16:00」根据会议议题起草主持词，先发我确认
每月最后一个工作日「15:00」起草下月工作部署会的讲话提纲
每年 12 月 20 日「10:00」起草年会致辞初稿
每个工作日「08:30」检查 inbound 目录新上传的讲话稿，估算时长并标出不好念的句子
每季度第一个工作日「10:00」整理上季度亮点素材，供讲话稿引用
en: Every Monday at 09:00, list the speeches needed for this week's meetings and their deadlines
The day before each regular meeting at 16:00, draft the host script for my review
On the last weekday of each month at 15:00, outline next month's kick-off speech
On December 20 each year at 10:00, draft the year-end address
Every weekday at 08:30, check new speech drafts in inbound, estimate timing, and flag hard-to-read lines
On the first weekday of each quarter at 10:00, collect last quarter's highlights for future speeches
